criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.evidence: Line one names the mechanism and the September 18th, 2026 order; line two states the $50,000 per MW posting condition.

criteria.name: Mechanism significance for Texas
criteria.evidence: A real ERCOT gate for large load interconnection, but one rule in one grid; significance is structural rather than statewide.

criteria.name: Layer fidelity
criteria.evidence: Five layers, each with a named actor and a primary source (SB 6 enrolled text and the PUCT order); actor phrases match the dossier.

criteria.name: Chokepoint clarity
criteria.evidence: One actor and one binary decision, in the dossier's exact phrasing: post financial security before study inclusion.

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.evidence: Revised to add the June 18th, 2026 batch zero reference from the order, placing the rule beside an existing queue process; the measurable items are named.

criteria.name: Forward implication
criteria.evidence: Revised to point at the Project No. 58481 filing record that lists items 218 and 219 from September 18th, 2026; the Texas Register republication date is still unscheduled.

criteria.name: Primary-source quality
criteria.evidence: Body-fetched PUCT order PDF (100 pages), PUCT filing record, and enrolled SB 6 text; hashes are in the dossier.

criteria.name: Texas AI Docket voice
criteria.evidence: Plain and specific, with no first person or hype. Ends on a question about the chokepoint.

criteria.name: LinkedIn readability
criteria.evidence: 425 body words, short bullets, one hook, three approved hashtags.

criteria.name: Chokepoint question
criteria.evidence: Asks whether a per-MW posting screens speculation or shifts its cost, tied to the dossier decision.
